messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data, so I can’t tell you the exact current time in New York City right now. You could check a reliable world clock or your device’s time settings for the most accurate information.

We can say we cannot provide real-time info. Possibly we can use the function to get weather forecast which might include time? No. There's no function for time. So we should respond that we can't give real-time.
